title: Heidi Gainzz
author: Mike Fitz 💪
desc: 4 Day Program: Upper, Lower, Rest, Upper, Lower, Rest, Rest. You can use a rest day to do HIT cardio. Be sure to progressively overload your work week to week, try to do an extra rep or a little bit more weight than last time if you are able to.
